prompt_md: Two players take turns throwing darts that land uniformly at random on a round board. First to land within half the radius of the center wins. Chance the starter wins?
prompt_short: Alternate random darts; first within half the radius wins. First thrower?
hint_md: What's the chance a single dart hits?
explain_intuition_md: The inner zone has half the radius but only a quarter of the area, so each dart hits with chance 1 in 4. Going first gives you the first shot in every round, and with such a low hit rate that edge adds up to 4 in 7. It looks like a fair game, which is why 50% tempts.
